//: The directional-property ban from the enforcement table in _AI_CONTEXT/01_RULES.md. Logical properties are what make RTL a `dir` attribute instead of a rewrite: `margin-inline-start` mirrors itself in Arabic, `margin-left` does not. No shared config is extended on purpose, so Tailwind v4's at-rules (@theme, @custom-variant, @utility) do not need an allow-list.

property-disallowed-list.message: Use the logical property instead: margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end, border-inline-start, inset-inline-start. See _AI_CONTEXT/01_RULES.md.
